sn35.70:1.1: atha kho āyasmā upavāṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
sn35.70:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.70:1.3: sandiṭṭhiko dhammo sandiṭṭhiko dhammoti bhante vuccati
sn35.70:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
sn35.70:2.1: idha pana upavāṇa bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rūparāgapaṭisaṃvedī ca
sn35.70:2.2: santañca ajjhattaṃ rūpesu rāgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ rūpesu rāgoti pajānāti.
sn35.70:2.3: yantaṃ upavāṇa bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rūparāgapaṭisaṃvedī ca
sn35.70:2.4: santañca ajjhattaṃ rūpesu rāgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ rūpesu rāgoti pajānāti.
sn35.70:2.5: evampi kho upavāṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti …pe…
sn35.70:3.1: puna caparaṃ upavāṇa bhikkhu jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā rasapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rasarāgapaṭisaṃvedī ca
sn35.70:3.2: santañca ajjhattaṃ rasesu rāgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ rasesu rāgoti pajānāti.

sn35.70:3.4: santañca ajjhattaṃ rasesu rāgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ rasesu rāgoti pajānāti. evampi kho upavāṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
sn35.70:4.1: puna caparaṃ upavāṇa bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammarāgapaṭisaṃvedī ca
sn35.70:4.2: santañca ajjhattaṃ dhammesu rāgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammesu rāgoti pajānāti.
sn35.70:4.3: yantaṃ upavāṇa bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammarāgapaṭisaṃvedī ca
sn35.70:4.4: santañca ajjhattaṃ dhammesu rāgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammesu rāgoti pajānāti.
sn35.70:4.5: evampi kho upavāṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti …pe… paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
sn35.70:5.1: idha pana upavāṇa bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti no ca rūparāgapaṭisaṃvedī
sn35.70:5.2: asantañca ajjhattaṃ rūpesu rāgaṃ natthi me ajjhattaṃ rūpesu rāgoti pajānāti.
sn35.70:5.3: yantaṃ upavāṇa bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpapaṭisaṃvedī hi kho hoti no ca rūparāgapaṭisaṃvedī
sn35.70:5.4: asantañca ajjhattaṃ rūpesu rāgaṃ natthi me ajjhattaṃ rūpesu rāgoti pajānāti.
sn35.70:5.5: evampi kho upavāṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
